I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. At 5 requests per second the minimum spacing is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves some margin. I haven't run the test, because it calls the real sandbox. Whether the CI flake is gone will only show in CI.

The loop makes 4 calls, so the sleep adds about 1s to the test. The delay is a `CALL_SPACING_S` constant at the top of the file.

I also saved the sandbox rate limit as a hazard memory in EngramDB, so future sessions know to space calls in any new sandbox tests.
